specification.objective: MAGI-011: render a collapsible per-record decision results panel, safe error summaries, aggregate counters, navigation to pending records, and only explicit repeat of failed rejections. Retain feedback across Magi tabs.

requirements.statement: Render every API item once, with id/status/safe error and separate applied/rejected/failed/reconciliation counts.
Offer selection/navigation only when record remains pending, clearing filters when needed; no automatic mutation or retry.
Offer explicit retry only for a failed reject of a currently pending record; never retry approve or applied_cleanup_failed automatically.
Lift confirmation, result and feedback state to MagiPage so navigating between pending and stored modes preserves them.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Executable tests exercise result normalization, preservation of all item entries, counters, safe errors and retry policy.
Desktop code tests verify accessible details panel, selection of pending item and explicit safe retry path.
Component state for confirmation/feedback survives MagiPage navigation; partial/failed not styled as complete.
POLIS strict regression, tests, verification and docs pass.

invariants.statement: No writes except previously authorized manual decision. No automatic retry, never treat applied_cleanup_failed as safe to repeat.
Do not display arbitrary raw errors containing sensitive content.

forbidden_states.statement: Implicit retry on refresh/re-render, bulk retry of potentially applied operations, or duplicated results.

inputs.statement: TASKS.md MAGI-011 and MAGI-002 decision response fields, MAGI-004 recovery status.

outputs.statement: Desktop review result panel, safe retry control, preserved view state, regressions.

failure_semantics.statement: Unknown item failures show safe generic message while permitting record inspection.
